A failure of the DeTemple complete-monotonicity threshold

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

We refute the sufficient direction of Yang–Chu–Zhang Conjecture 1(ii) at a strictly positive parameter strictly below 155/294. The literal gamma/digamma quotient violates a positive-input midpoint inequality, hence its proposed negative is not completely monotone. The existential strictly interior source refutation is proved in Lean; the separately calculated rational witness is mathematical evidence, not the formal endpoint. Part (i) and an exact replacement threshold are not claimed.

AI-assisted preprint by Myeongjin Kang, with no affiliation. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review. The accompanying Lean certificate covers the precise scoped main statement; inspect the formal endpoint, assumptions and provenance in the supporting package. Prior-art investigations are documented bounded searches, not worldwide-priority certification. The public supporting ZIP contains original proof sources and verification evidence, with bibliographic links and hashes instead of redistributed third-party source manuscripts.
